detail: Expected result 'The message is not shown after the reload' is not in the story: it only says the message goes away once a valid quantity is applied. Drop the assertion or move it to Open questions. [raised by opus, sol]

The case's input 5000000000 appears in no frame: the pre-Enter frame shows '0000' in the narrow input and no 'Typed 5000000000' label because demo.highlight's Playwright overlay is not recorded and mark() draws in-page only after the overlay is gone. No later caption names the value either. Draw an in-page 'Typed 5000000000' caption before Enter and keep it through the post-Enter frames. [raised by opus, sol]
Same as TC-BUG-46-03: frame 04 shows '0000' and no label, and no caption after Enter names 5000000000, so the video does not show which value produced the message. [raised by opus, sol]
Same as TC-BUG-46-03: frame 06 shows '0000' in the backpack input with no label or caption naming 5000000000. [raised by opus, sol]
